title: PrototypeRootAPI
summary: Native-instancing tag on a generated prototype root (/__Prototype_<n>). Prototype content is published once there; the compiled cache stores paths below it by stable names resolved through the instancing graph.
producer_scope: Written by ovstage population on every generated /__Prototype_<n> root.
notes: No USD schema applies this name and it declares no column; the parser keys native instancing on the ovstage instancing queries (instance and prototype roots), not on attributes.
